own_solution.law: Isothermal quasi-static ideal-gas work W = p1 V1 ln(V2/V1)

defect_reasons.other: TC41F and T6073 say the expansion continues to 3.4 times the initial volume after the problem says it goes to 2 times; read with 'the work covers the whole expansion' as a continuation of the same slow isothermal process (total 3.4x), but the wording sits close to a restatement of the end point and does not restate that the continued part is isothermal.

notes: p1V1 = 200e3 Pa * 0.005 m^3 = 1000 J. Base W = 1000 ln 2 = 693.15 J. With 3.4x: W = 1000 ln 3.4 = 1223.78 J. Temperature enters W = nRT ln(V2/V1) but nRT = p1V1 is fixed, so it cancels. Second cylinder and earlier experiment are disconnected.
